mapper.select: SELECT id, enterprise_id, webhook_id, actor_user_id, idempotency_key, payload_hash, trace_id, status, provider_http_status, provider_errcode, provider_errmsg, attempt_count, create_time, update_time FROM wc_webhook_delivery WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wc_webhook_delivery (enterprise_id, webhook_id, actor_user_id, idempotency_key, payload_hash, trace_id, status, attempt_count) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{webhookId}, #{actorUserId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{payloadHash}, #{traceId}, #{status}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE wc_webhook_delivery SET status = #{status}, provider_http_status = #{providerHttpStatus}, provider_errcode = #{providerErrcode}, provider_errmsg = #{providerErrmsg}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}

UPDATE wc_webhook_delivery SET status = 'UNKNOWN', provider_errmsg = 'stale pending delivery requires reconciliation', update_time = NOW() WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND status = 'PENDING' AND update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE)

UPDATE wc_webhook_delivery SET status = 'UNKNOWN', provider_errmsg = 'stale pending delivery requires reconciliation', update_time = NOW() WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE) ORDER BY update_time LIMIT 500
